title: These Are Great!
text: These Are Great!. These iced coffee sleeves are great! They are awesome for keeping the sweaty cup from dripping in your car or on your hand. The cow design is very cute!  The smallest one is the one to use for Starbucks Grande. They do have a strong smell when you first open them, as other neoprene items have, but it doesn't last too long.

product_metadata.title: YR Reusable Neoprene Insulator Sleeve for Iced Coffee Cups, 3 Pack Coffee Coolies sleeves for Iced & Hot Drinks, Cold Beverage Cooler Compatible with Starbucks Dunkin Coffee and More
features: 3 SIZES: SMALL for 16-18oz, MEDIUM for 22-24oz, LARGE for 32oz

KEEP YOUR ICED DRINK COLD: Our high quality iced drink sleeve made of 4mm thick neoprene keeping your iced drink longer. You can drink your iced drink slowly without worry about your iced drink getting to normal temperature too fast while your work is getting done.

NO MORE CONDENSATION ON YOUR HANDS & AVOID SPILLS: Enjoy your iced drink with dry hands while avoiding wet spots, table rings, desk stains, puddles and more. Our stretchy material is designed to capture condensation and be ultra-soft to the touch.

STRETCHES TO FIT A VARIETY OF CUPS: Our perfectly designed iced cup insulator holder fits popular brands, including Grande, Venti and Trenta Starbucks, Dunkin Donuts, McDonalds. Also fits other popular iced drink brands, water bottles, and tumblers.
REUSABLE & WASHABLE: Our perfectly designed iced cup insulator holder replaces disposable paper cup sleeves and napkins. Our iced drink sleeve can be hand-washed in warm water and air-dried.
